title: KSB tracker and camera performance fixed
details: Legacy blank yellow KSB circles are removed while learner, RPL, assessor and witness ticks remain unchanged
Recent Functional Skills and ARP helpers no longer watch the whole app continuously
Photo capture now uses the existing single native 1024px JPEG encoding path instead of processing the same shot twice
MCQ, Discussion, Practical, Maths, English, Targets and evidence content are unchanged
summary: Evia v201 removes the unwanted KSB circles and reduces background work that could slow navigation and photo capture.
changes: Removed the obsolete per-KSB marker element when Course coverage opens
Preserved yellow learner, purple RPL, blue assessor and orange witness ticks
Removed three recent full-page observers and the camera-return focus retry
Removed duplicate canvas photo conversion while retaining the existing image size and quality path
